examples.title: The initial transform of sMRIPrep's brain extraction, by fMRIPrep, ANTs and larmorx
examples.summary: fMRIPrep 25.2.6's `init_aff` node (antsAI's multi-start search: rotations around the principal axes, an Affine local search with Mattes MI) on OpenNeuro ds000005 sub-01, with its arguments, inputs and seed; and niworkflows' antsAffineInitializer call on the same images. Each transform is shown as the T1w it places on the template (resampled by ANTs as built, linear), as its parameters and as distances in mm.

facts.label: Data
facts.text: OpenNeuro ds000005 (Tom et al., 2007), snapshot 00001, sub-01's T1w (PDDL-1.0); the OASIS30ANTs template (Avants et al., CC BY 4.0, TemplateFlow); shown inside the template's brain mask, dilated by 2 voxels

facts.label: Also
facts.text: `antsAffineInitializer 3 <fixed> <moving> out.mat 15 0.1 0 10` (niworkflows' arguments; fMRIPrep 25.2.6 does not call it here)
